components.name: Primary action
components.description: Blue pill used for the principal page action.
components.css: .ds-primary{font-family:var(--sans, 'Index Inter', 'PingFang SC', 'Hiragino Kaku Gothic ProN', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif);display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:10px;min-height:52px;padding:14px 32px;border:1px solid #285de5;border-radius:999px;font-size:16px;line-height:22px;font-weight:500;text-decoration:none;cursor:pointer;transition:background-color .2s,border-color .2s,transform .2s;background:#285de5;color:#fff}.ds-primary:hover{background:#1d4ed8;border-color:#1d4ed8}.ds-primary:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--blue,#2563eb);outline-offset:4px}@media(hover:hover) and (pointer:fine){.ds-primary:hover{transform:translateY(-1px)}}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-primary{transition:none!important;transform:none!important}}

components.name: Secondary action
components.description: White outlined pill used alongside the main action.
components.css: .ds-secondary{font-family:var(--sans, 'Index Inter', 'PingFang SC', 'Hiragino Kaku Gothic ProN', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif);display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:10px;min-height:52px;padding:14px 32px;border:1px solid #285de5;border-radius:999px;font-size:16px;line-height:22px;font-weight:500;text-decoration:none;cursor:pointer;transition:background-color .2s,border-color .2s,transform .2s;background:#fff;color:#111;border-color:#9ca3af}.ds-secondary:hover{background:#f8fafc;border-color:#475569}.ds-secondary:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--blue,#2563eb);outline-offset:4px}@media(hover:hover) and (pointer:fine){.ds-secondary:hover{transform:translateY(-1px)}}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-secondary{transition:none!important;transform:none!important}}

components.name: Contact field
components.description: Visible label and native editable input for the local draft.
components.css: .ds-field{display:grid;gap:8px;font:13px/1.65 var(--sans, 'Index Inter', 'PingFang SC', 'Hiragino Kaku Gothic ProN', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif);color:var(--ink,#101010)}.ds-field input{min-width:0;padding:11px 12px;border:1px solid #94a3b8;border-radius:6px;background:#fff;color:#111827;font:15px/1.5 var(--sans, 'Index Inter', 'PingFang SC', 'Hiragino Kaku Gothic ProN', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif);caret-color:var(--blue,#2563eb)}.ds-field input:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--blue,#2563eb);outline-offset:4px}

components.name: Module navigation
components.description: Five public modules with a distinct active route.
components.html: DirectionsNewsBenchmarksTeamContact
components.css: .ds-nav{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:24px;background:#fff;font-family:var(--sans, 'Index Inter', 'PingFang SC', 'Hiragino Kaku Gothic ProN', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif)}.ds-nav a{position:relative;font-size:14px;line-height:70px;font-weight:500;color:#111827;text-decoration:none;white-space:nowrap}.ds-nav a:hover,.ds-nav a[aria-current]{color:#1d4ed8}.ds-nav a[aria-current]:after{content:"";position:absolute;left:0;right:0;bottom:12px;height:2px;background:#2563eb}.ds-nav a:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--blue,#2563eb);outline-offset:4px}

components.name: Paper topic link
components.description: Independent visible topic link below a paper cover.
components.css: .ds-topic-links{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:5px 12px;font-family:var(--sans, 'Index Inter', 'PingFang SC', 'Hiragino Kaku Gothic ProN', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif)}.ds-topic-links a{font-size:11px;line-height:1.8;color:#4f6255;text-underline-offset:4px}.ds-topic-links a:hover{text-decoration:underline}.ds-topic-links a:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--blue,#2563eb);outline-offset:4px}

components.name: Research paper cover
components.description: Flat topic-colored typographic cover; original titles may grow freely.
components.html:

components.css: .ds-paper{max-width:380px;font-family:var(--sans, 'Index Inter', 'PingFang SC', 'Hiragino Kaku Gothic ProN', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif);background:#fff}.ds-paper-cover{display:flex;flex-direction:column;min-height:254px;padding:24px;background:var(--block-blue,#e0eaf4);color:var(--ink,#101010);text-decoration:none;transition:transform .42s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)}.ds-paper-meta{font-size:11px;line-height:1.7;color:#42483f;margin-bottom:22px}.ds-paper h3{font-size:22px;line-height:1.35;font-weight:500;letter-spacing:-.025em;overflow-wrap:anywhere;margin:0 0 20px}.ds-paper h3 span{display:inline-block;transition:transform .42s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)}.ds-paper-cover p{margin:auto 0 0;padding-top:14px;font-size:12px;line-height:1.7;color:#3d473e}.ds-paper-authors{margin:14px 0 0;font-size:12px;line-height:1.65;color:#535b53}.ds-paper-cover:hover h3{color:#314d40}.ds-paper-cover:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--ink,#101010);outline-offset:5px}.ds-paper-cover:focus-visible h3 span{transform:translate(4px,-4px)}@media(hover:hover) and (pointer:fine){.ds-paper:hover .ds-paper-cover{transform:translateY(-5px)}.ds-paper:hover h3 span{transform:translate(4px,-4px)}}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-paper-cover,.ds-paper h3 span{transition:none!important;transform:none!important}}

narrative.overview:
The chosen visual world is a clear, public research entrance: white space, decisive sans headings and source-linked collections. The homepage carries the user-selected AstroWind framework; resource pages adapt Madeo's flat color blocks to dense research metadata. These are the established references, not permission to import unrelated agency content.

Dark text and cool slate copy keep the reading calm. Blue controls make paths visible, solid violet gives the hero a single point of emphasis, and pale topic fields organize collections without implying research quality. Inter and CJK sans fallbacks replace the earlier editorial serif identity throughout shared headings and wordmarks.
keyCharacteristics: Clear sans hierarchy with balanced headings.
Flat topic fields with original source metadata.
Restrained, progressive motion with visible default content.

rules.name: White Canvas
rules.body: White is the page base; pale fills organize sections and topic blocks rather than replacing it.

rules.name: Original Title
rules.body: Scientific titles wrap in full; retain the source wording and let block height grow.

rules.name: Flat Resource
rules.body: Research blocks use color and spacing for separation, without card shadows or rounded containers.

dos: Do keep the base canvas white and use the documented sans family in shared headings and wordmarks.
Do keep topic labels visible alongside their consistent pastel color.
Do preserve full original scientific titles and independent source/topic links.
Do keep content visible before motion and cancel spatial feedback for reduced motion.
Do use the actual button fill token; the primary control/focus token is a distinct blue.
donts: Don't restore the previous serif/news-first homepage identity.
Don't turn resource blocks into rounded, shadowed cards.
Don't use a gradient for the solid violet hero emphasis.
Don't invent paper artwork, research figures, scores or people to fill a block.
Don't hide or clamp scientific titles to equalize card height.
